create_get_json_schema: create a JSON schema from a Python function using its type hints and Google-style docstring
run_render_jinja_template: run a Jinja2 chat template on conversation messages to produce formatted chat output
test_is_valid_message: test whether a message dict has the required 'role' and 'content' keys for a valid chat message
build_chat_class: build a Chat instance from a list of message dicts with role and content keys
summarize_get_template_variables: summarize the undeclared variables referenced in a Jinja2 chat template string
